findings.summary: Spec items 4-5 require live drills against the real bus refs endpoint (not a mocked adapter) and a restart-idempotency drill, with evidence recorded in durable development evidence. No such evidence was recorded in the implement handoff; the verification_record contains only the three dd-acceptance commands (uv sync --frozen, make verify, uv run pytest -q -k resolver). The acceptance script scripts/e1_decision_bridge_acceptance.py exists and correctly mirrors the real bus refs endpoint contract, but uses a FakeBus rather than the real agent-bus, so it does not satisfy the 'not a mocked adapter' requirement even if run.

The implementation correctly establishes the real bus refs endpoint contract (GET /v1/entities/<id>/refs returning {"refs": [{"message_id", "target_entity"}]}) throughout BusClient.refs_to (client.py:163-166), Board.decision_for (board.py:347), the resolver's _referenced_questions reverse-lookup (resolver.py:91-122), and the bridge's _refs_to seam (bridge.py:279-290). The 13 focused resolver tests exercise the correct contract shape; test_refs_are_resolved_through_the_real_endpoint (test_decision_bridge.py:294) explicitly verifies the question comes from the reverse-refs endpoint rather than an inline refs field. The change is minimal and correct.
